mapper.insert: INSERT INTO refresh_token ( uid, refresh_token, access_token_jti, expires_at, created_at, last_used_at, device_info, ip_address, revoked, revoked_at, revoke_reason ) VALUES ( #{uid}, #{refreshToken}, #{accessTokenJti}, #{expiresAt}, #{createdAt}, #{lastUsedAt}, #{deviceInfo}, #{ipAddress}, #{revoked}, #{revokedAt}, #{revokeReason} )
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM refresh_token WHERE refresh_token = #{refreshToken} LIMIT 1
SELECT * FROM refresh_token WHERE uid = #{uid} AND revoked = 0 AND expires_at > NOW() ORDER BY created_at DESC
SELECT * FROM refresh_token WHERE uid = #{uid} ORDER BY created_at DESC
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM refresh_token WHERE expires_at < NOW()
DELETE FROM refresh_token WHERE revoked = 1 AND revoked_at < DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL #{days} DAY)
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM refresh_token WHERE uid = #{uid} AND revoked = 0 AND expires_at > NOW()
